component.name: Reshaped Radio
component.description: Works like a native radio button with value passed to the form on submission, in controlled or uncontrolled mode. Comes in three sizes, supports error and disabled states, and a RadioGroup compound for exclusive selection with any layout, FormControl group labels and card-based composition.
